title: ThreadWeaver: Adaptive Threading for Efficient Parallel Reasoning in Language Models

layout.note: A dashed prompt box on top; below it two aligned horizontal lanes: a thin Sequential line of five steps ending in a spinner, and a ThreadWeaver line whose two tinted Parallel inference blocks fork into two and three dashed thread boxes and join again, ending in the answer and a trophy; rotated lane names and GPU icons sit at the left.

lesson: Contrast serial and parallel execution by drawing the same steps on two aligned lanes under one shared prompt: the baseline stays a single arrow ending in a spinner, the proposed lane forks into dashed thread boxes inside tinted blocks, joins again and ends in the answer, with numbered GPU icons showing the extra compute.
